scripts.build:clean: powershell -Command "Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; if (Test-Path .next) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next }; npm run build"
scripts.clean: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path .next) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next; Write-Host 'Build directory deleted successfully' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'No build directory found' -ForegroundColor Yellow }"
